description: Now (as filed, before S1/S2; re-measure on fz-nml.6 head d8e93a65b): each non-ASCII character ends the run; Utf8.next makes a {:ok, cp, rest} tuple and a new binary, and acc <> run <> cp copies the accumulated string twice. 333 x 世: 334 structs, 624 shared bins, 332,280 shared bytes. 333 x \u4e16: 332,280 shared bytes. Change: a run continues through <<c::utf8, r::binary>> when c >= 128; \u appends <<cp::utf8>> directly; invalid UTF-8 reaches the failing clause with the byte in hand. Predicted: 世 struct 334 -> 0, shared bytes -> 0 (the string is a view of the input); \u shared bytes -> <= 2,100. Deletes Utf8.from_codepoint/1 if lib no longer uses it, with fixtures2/behavior/utf8_from_codepoint.fz; unicode_scalar and its unreachable :invalid_codepoint arm; run_join's second slice. Fixes fixture 01164's false header and lowers its pins. KEEPS Utf8.next/1 and fz_bitstring_utf8_prefix (revised 2026-11-15): JSON.encode!'s cold failure path (fz-nml.6) asks Utf8.next where the utf8 match failed, which is the one UTF-8 authority; the decoder's hot path stops using it. Updates .agent/docs/semantic-authorities.md UTF-8 paragraphs to match. Needs S3 (merged). Base: fz-nml.6 (PR #621). Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-json-garbage.html (approved 2026-11-14).
title: A JSON string decodes in one pass, and a string without escapes is a view of the input
